name: Recall Memory
description: Long-term memory from Recall: adds what it knows about the user to each turn, records conversations so it keeps learning, and adds memory tools.

url.description: Recall server URL (default: RECALL_URL, ~/.recall/config.json, else https://api.recallmem.dev)

peer.description: Your peer id in Recall; keep it stable (default: your OS user name)

assistantPeer.description: Peer the assistant's replies are recorded as (default: openclaw)

lookup.description: When to add memory to the prompt

recordAutomated.description: Also record heartbeat and cron turns (default: false)

peerFromSender.description: Use the channel sender as the peer, for assistants shared by several people (default: false)

contextTokens.description: Size of the memory added to a turn (default: 1200)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for memory lookups and recording (default: 4000)
